usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.chat.completions.list(model="model", metadata={"key": "string"}, after="after", limit=20, order="asc")
print(result)

typeReference.signature: client.chat.completions.list(model=..., metadata=..., after=..., limit=..., order=...) -> CursorPage[CreateChatCompletionResponse]

fields.name: model
fields.description: The model used to generate the Chat Completions.

fields.name: metadata
fields.description:
A list of metadata keys to filter the Chat Completions by. Example:

`metadata[key1]=value1&metadata[key2]=value2`

fields.name: after
fields.description: Identifier for the last chat completion from the previous pagination request.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Number of Chat Completions to retrieve.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order for Chat Completions by timestamp. Use `asc` for ascending order or `desc` for descending order. Defaults to `asc`.

fields.name: id
fields.description: A unique identifier for the chat completion.

fields.name: choices
fields.description: A list of chat completion choices. Can be more than one if `n` is greater than 1.

fields.name: created
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the chat completion was created.

fields.name: model
fields.description: The model used for the chat completion.

fields.name: system_fingerprint
fields.description:
This fingerprint represents the backend configuration that the model runs with.

Can be used in conjunction with the `seed` request parameter to understand when backend changes have been made that might impact determinism.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `chat.completion`.
